import json
import os
import sys
import time
import uuid
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path('/home/r/dev/minor/stackd')
sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT / 'scripts/aws'))
from aws_cli import observe

ACCOUNT = '000000000000'
SRC = 'us-east-1'
DST = 'us-west-2'
PREFIX = 'stackd-sns-regsqs-' + uuid.uuid4().hex[:12]
OUT = ROOT / 'testdata/aws/sns/regional_sqs.json'
data = {'account': ACCOUNT, 'source_region': SRC, 'destination_region': DST, 'prefix': PREFIX,
        'observations': [], 'receipts': [], 'cleanup': [], 'publish_ids': {},
        'primary_references': ['https://docs.aws.amazon.com/sns/latest/dg/sns-cross-region-delivery.html',
        'https://docs.aws.amazon.com/sns/latest/dg/sns-dead-letter-queues.html',
        'https://docs.aws.amazon.com/sns/latest/dg/fifo-message-delivery.html'],
        'limitations': ['Only same-account us-east-1 to us-west-2 was exercised. No opt-in Region behavior is inferred.',
        'Empty receives in bounded delivery windows are not universal non-delivery guarantees.',
        'Raw receipts are correlated by unique literal body; wrapped receipts are correlated by SNS MessageId.'],
        'disposable_sources': {}}
topics = []
queues = []
subs = []

def save():
    OUT.write_text(json.dumps(data, indent=2) + '\n')

def obs(label, region, service, operation, params, cleanup=False):
    environment = dict(os.environ, AWS_REGION=region, AWS_DEFAULT_REGION=region,
                       AWS_MAX_ATTEMPTS='1', AWS_PAGER='')
    result = observe(service, operation, params, environment)
    record = {'label': label, 'region': region, 'service': service, 'operation': operation,
              'input': params, 'result': result, 'observed': datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()}
    data['cleanup' if cleanup else 'observations'].append(record)
    save()
    print(label, result['code'], flush=True)
    return result

def success(result):
    if result['code'] != 'Success':
        raise RuntimeError(json.dumps(result))
    return result['output']

def topic(suffix, fifo=False):
    name = PREFIX + '-' + suffix
    attrs = {'FifoTopic': 'true', 'ContentBasedDeduplication': 'false'} if fifo else {}
    arn = success(obs('create-topic-' + suffix, SRC, 'sns', 'create-topic', {'Name': name, 'Attributes': attrs}))['TopicArn']
    topics.append(arn)
    return arn

def queue(suffix, region=DST, fifo=False):
    name = PREFIX + '-' + suffix
    attrs = {'FifoQueue': 'true', 'ContentBasedDeduplication': 'false'} if fifo else {}
    url = success(obs('create-queue-' + suffix, region, 'sqs', 'create-queue', {'QueueName': name, 'Attributes': attrs}))['QueueUrl']
    q = {'name': name, 'url': url, 'region': region}
    queues.append(q)
    q['arn'] = success(obs('queue-attributes-' + suffix, region, 'sqs', 'get-queue-attributes', {'QueueUrl': url, 'AttributeNames': ['All']}))['Attributes']['QueueArn']
    return q

def policy(q, arn, label, source_account=ACCOUNT, deny=False):
    statement = {'Sid': 'OwnedTopic', 'Effect': 'Allow', 'Principal': {'Service': 'sns.amazonaws.com'},
                 'Action': 'sqs:SendMessage', 'Resource': q['arn'],
                 'Condition': {'ArnEquals': {'aws:SourceArn': arn}, 'StringEquals': {'aws:SourceAccount': source_account}}}
    statements = [statement]
    if deny:
        statements.append({'Sid': 'DenySNSPrincipal', 'Effect': 'Deny', 'Principal': {'Service': 'sns.amazonaws.com'},
                           'Action': 'sqs:SendMessage', 'Resource': q['arn']})
    value = json.dumps({'Version': '2012-10-17', 'Statement': statements})
    success(obs(label, q['region'], 'sqs', 'set-queue-attributes', {'QueueUrl': q['url'], 'Attributes': {'Policy': value}}))
    obs(label + '-readback', q['region'], 'sqs', 'get-queue-attributes', {'QueueUrl': q['url'], 'AttributeNames': ['All']})

def subscribe(label, arn, endpoint, attrs=None, protocol='sqs'):
    params = {'TopicArn': arn, 'Protocol': protocol, 'Endpoint': endpoint, 'ReturnSubscriptionArn': True}
    if attrs is not None:
        params['Attributes'] = attrs
    result = obs(label, SRC, 'sns', 'subscribe', params)
    if result['code'] == 'Success':
        sub = result['output']['SubscriptionArn']
        if sub not in subs:
            subs.append(sub)
        obs(label + '-readback', SRC, 'sns', 'get-subscription-attributes', {'SubscriptionArn': sub})
        return sub
    return None

def publish(label, arn, fifo=False):
    body = json.dumps({'probe': PREFIX, 'case': label, 'value': 'original payload Δ\nline two'}, ensure_ascii=False)
    params = {'TopicArn': arn, 'Message': body, 'Subject': 'regional-original',
              'MessageAttributes': {'ProbeCase': {'DataType': 'String', 'StringValue': label},
                                    'Count': {'DataType': 'Number', 'StringValue': '12.50'}}}
    if fifo:
        params.update(MessageGroupId='regional-group-A', MessageDeduplicationId=PREFIX + '-' + label)
    result = obs('publish-' + label, SRC, 'sns', 'publish', params)
    if result['code'] == 'Success':
        data['publish_ids'][label] = {'message_id': result['output']['MessageId'], 'body': body, 'input': params}
        save()
    return result

def receive(q, label, expected_labels, seconds=65):
    deadline = time.monotonic() + seconds
    seen = set()
    attempts = 0
    started = datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()
    while time.monotonic() < deadline and not set(expected_labels).issubset(seen):
        attempts += 1
        result = obs(label + '-receive-' + str(attempts), q['region'], 'sqs', 'receive-message',
                     {'QueueUrl': q['url'], 'MaxNumberOfMessages': 10, 'WaitTimeSeconds': 10,
                      'MessageSystemAttributeNames': ['All'], 'MessageAttributeNames': ['All']})
        for message in result.get('output', {}).get('Messages', []):
            body = message['Body']
            try:
                decoded = json.loads(body)
            except ValueError:
                decoded = {}
            matched = [key for key, pub in data['publish_ids'].items()
                       if body == pub['body'] or decoded.get('MessageId') == pub['message_id']
                       or decoded.get('Message') == pub['body']]
            seen.update(matched)
            data['receipts'].append({'label': label, 'region': q['region'], 'destination': q['arn'],
                                     'message': message, 'correlated_publish_labels': matched,
                                     'correlated_publish_ids': [data['publish_ids'][key]['message_id'] for key in matched],
                                     'observed': datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()})
            save()
            obs(label + '-delete-receipt-' + str(len(data['receipts'])), q['region'], 'sqs', 'delete-message',
                {'QueueUrl': q['url'], 'ReceiptHandle': message['ReceiptHandle']})
    data.setdefault('delivery_windows', []).append({'label': label, 'destination': q['arn'], 'started': started,
        'finished': datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(), 'bound_seconds': seconds,
        'expected_publish_labels': expected_labels, 'seen_publish_labels': sorted(seen)})
    save()
    return seen

try:
    identity = success(obs('identity', SRC, 'sts', 'get-caller-identity', {}))
    if identity['Account'] != ACCOUNT or identity['Arn'] != 'arn:aws:iam::000000000000:user/Delegated':
        raise RuntimeError('Unexpected identity; refusing mutation')
    obs('account-regions-read-only', SRC, 'account', 'list-regions', {})
    standard = topic('standard')
    fifo = topic('fifo.fifo', True)
    policy_topic = topic('policy')
    wrapped = queue('wrapped')
    raw = queue('raw')
    fifo_q = queue('fifo.fifo', fifo=True)
    fifo_standard_q = queue('fifo-standard')
    policy_q = queue('policy')
    dlq = queue('subscription-dlq', SRC)
    for q, arn in [(wrapped, standard), (raw, standard), (fifo_q, fifo), (fifo_standard_q, fifo), (policy_q, policy_topic), (dlq, policy_topic)]:
        policy(q, arn, 'policy-correct-' + q['name'])
    wrapped_sub = subscribe('subscribe-standard-wrapped', standard, wrapped['arn'])
    raw_sub = subscribe('subscribe-standard-raw', standard, raw['arn'], {'RawMessageDelivery': 'true'})
    fifo_sub = subscribe('subscribe-fifo-to-fifo', fifo, fifo_q['arn'])
    fifo_standard_sub = subscribe('subscribe-fifo-to-standard', fifo, fifo_standard_q['arn'])
    policy_sub = subscribe('subscribe-policy-with-source-dlq', policy_topic, policy_q['arn'],
                           {'RedrivePolicy': json.dumps({'deadLetterTargetArn': dlq['arn']})})
    subscribe('error-standard-topic-fifo-queue', standard, fifo_q['arn'])
    subscribe('error-invalid-protocol-malformed-endpoint', standard, 'not-an-arn', protocol='unsupported')
    subscribe('error-sqs-malformed-endpoint', standard, 'not-an-arn')
    subscribe('error-sqs-endpoint-sns-service', standard, policy_topic.replace(':us-east-1:', ':us-west-2:'))
    subscribe('error-missing-topic-malformed-endpoint', standard + '-absent', 'not-an-arn')
    subscribe('error-missing-topic-fifo-endpoint', standard + '-absent', fifo_q['arn'])
    subscribe('error-topic-region-mismatch', standard.replace(':us-east-1:', ':us-west-2:'), wrapped['arn'])
    missing_endpoint = 'arn:aws:sqs:' + DST + ':' + ACCOUNT + ':' + PREFIX + '-never-created'
    subscribe('admission-nonexistent-regional-queue', standard, missing_endpoint)
    time.sleep(10)
    publish('standard-original', standard)
    receive(wrapped, 'standard-wrapped', ['standard-original'])
    receive(raw, 'standard-raw', ['standard-original'])
    publish('fifo-original', fifo, True)
    if fifo_sub:
        receive(fifo_q, 'fifo-to-fifo', ['fifo-original'])
    if fifo_standard_sub:
        receive(fifo_standard_q, 'fifo-to-standard', ['fifo-original'])
    publish('policy-positive-original', policy_topic)
    receive(policy_q, 'policy-positive-original', ['policy-positive-original'])
    for label, source, account, deny in [
        ('policy-wrong-source-region', policy_topic.replace(':us-east-1:', ':us-west-2:'), ACCOUNT, False),
        ('policy-wrong-source-account', policy_topic, '999000999000', False),
        ('policy-denied-principal', policy_topic, ACCOUNT, True)]:
        policy(policy_q, source, label, source_account=account, deny=deny)
        time.sleep(12)
        publish(label, policy_topic)
        receive(dlq, label + '-source-dlq', [label], seconds=95)
        receive(policy_q, label + '-destination-window', [label], seconds=12)
    policy(policy_q, policy_topic, 'policy-repaired')
    time.sleep(12)
    publish('policy-repaired', policy_topic)
    receive(policy_q, 'policy-repaired', ['policy-repaired'])
    obs('final-policy-subscription-configuration', SRC, 'sns', 'get-subscription-attributes', {'SubscriptionArn': policy_sub})
except Exception as exc:
    data['probe_error'] = type(exc).__name__ + ': ' + str(exc)
    save()
    print(data['probe_error'], flush=True)
finally:
    for sub in subs:
        try:
            obs('unsubscribe-' + sub.rsplit(':', 1)[-1], SRC, 'sns', 'unsubscribe', {'SubscriptionArn': sub}, cleanup=True)
        except Exception as exc:
            data.setdefault('cleanup_errors', []).append(str(exc))
    for arn in topics:
        try:
            obs('delete-topic-' + arn.rsplit(':', 1)[-1], SRC, 'sns', 'delete-topic', {'TopicArn': arn}, cleanup=True)
        except Exception as exc:
            data.setdefault('cleanup_errors', []).append(str(exc))
    for q in queues:
        try:
            obs('delete-queue-' + q['name'], q['region'], 'sqs', 'delete-queue', {'QueueUrl': q['url']}, cleanup=True)
        except Exception as exc:
            data.setdefault('cleanup_errors', []).append(str(exc))
    time.sleep(3)
    for sub in subs:
        obs('verify-subscription-absent-' + sub.rsplit(':', 1)[-1], SRC, 'sns', 'get-subscription-attributes', {'SubscriptionArn': sub}, cleanup=True)
    for arn in topics:
        obs('verify-topic-absent-' + arn.rsplit(':', 1)[-1], SRC, 'sns', 'get-topic-attributes', {'TopicArn': arn}, cleanup=True)
    for q in queues:
        obs('verify-queue-absent-' + q['name'], q['region'], 'sqs', 'get-queue-attributes', {'QueueUrl': q['url'], 'AttributeNames': ['QueueArn']}, cleanup=True)
        obs('verify-queue-name-absent-' + q['name'], q['region'], 'sqs', 'get-queue-url', {'QueueName': q['name']}, cleanup=True)
    obs('verify-east-owned-queue-list-empty', SRC, 'sqs', 'list-queues', {'QueueNamePrefix': PREFIX}, cleanup=True)
    obs('verify-west-owned-queue-list-empty', DST, 'sqs', 'list-queues', {'QueueNamePrefix': PREFIX}, cleanup=True)
    data['owned_resources'] = {'topics': topics, 'subscriptions': subs, 'queues': queues}
    data['disposable_sources']['probe.py'] = Path(__file__).read_text()
    save()

import json
import os
import sys
import time
import uuid
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from pathlib import Path
ROOT = Path('/home/r/dev/minor/stackd')
sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT / 'scripts/aws'))
from aws_cli import observe
ACCOUNT = '000000000000'
OUT = ROOT / 'testdata/aws/sns/regional_sqs.json'
data = json.loads(OUT.read_text())
PREFIX = 'stackd-sns-regopt-' + uuid.uuid4().hex[:12]
topics = []
queues = []
subs = []
cases = []

def save():
    OUT.write_text(json.dumps(data, indent=2) + '\n')

def obs(label, region, service, operation, params, cleanup=False):
    result = observe(service, operation, params, dict(os.environ, AWS_REGION=region, AWS_DEFAULT_REGION=region, AWS_MAX_ATTEMPTS='1', AWS_PAGER=''))
    data['cleanup' if cleanup else 'observations'].append({'label': 'optin-' + label, 'region': region,
        'service': service, 'operation': operation, 'input': params, 'result': result,
        'observed': datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()})
    save()
    print(label, result['code'], flush=True)
    return result

def success(result):
    if result['code'] != 'Success':
        raise RuntimeError(json.dumps(result))
    return result['output']

def topic(region):
    arn = success(obs('topic-' + region, region, 'sns', 'create-topic', {'Name': PREFIX + '-' + region}))['TopicArn']
    topics.append({'region': region, 'arn': arn})
    return arn

def queue(label, region, arn, principals):
    name = PREFIX + '-' + label
    url = success(obs('queue-' + label, region, 'sqs', 'create-queue', {'QueueName': name}))['QueueUrl']
    q = {'name': name, 'url': url, 'region': region}
    queues.append(q)
    q['arn'] = success(obs('queue-attributes-' + label, region, 'sqs', 'get-queue-attributes', {'QueueUrl': url, 'AttributeNames': ['All']}))['Attributes']['QueueArn']
    policy = {'Version': '2012-10-17', 'Statement': [{'Effect': 'Allow', 'Principal': {'Service': principals},
        'Action': 'sqs:SendMessage', 'Resource': q['arn'], 'Condition': {'ArnEquals': {'aws:SourceArn': arn},
        'StringEquals': {'aws:SourceAccount': ACCOUNT}}}]}
    success(obs('policy-' + label, region, 'sqs', 'set-queue-attributes', {'QueueUrl': url, 'Attributes': {'Policy': json.dumps(policy)}}))
    obs('policy-readback-' + label, region, 'sqs', 'get-queue-attributes', {'QueueUrl': url, 'AttributeNames': ['All']})
    return q

def subscribe(label, region, arn, q, dlq, principals):
    attributes = {'RedrivePolicy': json.dumps({'deadLetterTargetArn': dlq['arn']}),
                  'FilterPolicy': json.dumps({'ProbeCase': [label]})}
    result = obs('subscribe-' + label, region, 'sns', 'subscribe', {'TopicArn': arn, 'Protocol': 'sqs',
                 'Endpoint': q['arn'], 'ReturnSubscriptionArn': True, 'Attributes': attributes})
    if result['code'] != 'Success':
        return
    sub = {'region': region, 'arn': result['output']['SubscriptionArn']}
    subs.append(sub)
    obs('subscription-readback-' + label, region, 'sns', 'get-subscription-attributes', {'SubscriptionArn': sub['arn']})
    cases.append({'label': label, 'source_region': region, 'destination_region': q['region'], 'topic': arn,
        'queue': q, 'dead_letter_queue': dlq, 'allowed_service_principal': principals, 'subscription': sub['arn']})

def publish(case):
    label = case['label']
    body = json.dumps({'probe': PREFIX, 'case': label, 'payload': 'native opt-in principal proof'})
    params = {'TopicArn': case['topic'], 'Message': body,
              'MessageAttributes': {'ProbeCase': {'DataType': 'String', 'StringValue': label}}}
    result = obs('publish-' + label, case['source_region'], 'sns', 'publish', params)
    if result['code'] == 'Success':
        data['publish_ids'][label] = {'message_id': result['output']['MessageId'], 'body': body, 'input': params}
        save()

def receive(q, label, expected, seconds):
    started = datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()
    deadline = time.monotonic() + seconds
    seen = set()
    count = 0
    while time.monotonic() < deadline and not set(expected).issubset(seen):
        count += 1
        result = obs(label + '-receive-' + str(count), q['region'], 'sqs', 'receive-message',
            {'QueueUrl': q['url'], 'MaxNumberOfMessages': 10, 'WaitTimeSeconds': 10,
             'MessageSystemAttributeNames': ['All'], 'MessageAttributeNames': ['All']})
        for message in result.get('output', {}).get('Messages', []):
            body = message['Body']
            try:
                decoded = json.loads(body)
            except ValueError:
                decoded = {}
            matched = [key for key, pub in data['publish_ids'].items() if body == pub['body']
                or decoded.get('MessageId') == pub['message_id'] or decoded.get('Message') == pub['body']]
            seen.update(matched)
            data['receipts'].append({'label': 'optin-' + label, 'region': q['region'], 'destination': q['arn'],
                'message': message, 'correlated_publish_labels': matched,
                'correlated_publish_ids': [data['publish_ids'][key]['message_id'] for key in matched],
                'observed': datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()})
            save()
            obs(label + '-delete-receipt-' + str(len(data['receipts'])), q['region'], 'sqs', 'delete-message',
                {'QueueUrl': q['url'], 'ReceiptHandle': message['ReceiptHandle']})
    data['delivery_windows'].append({'label': 'optin-' + label, 'destination': q['arn'], 'started': started,
        'finished': datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(), 'bound_seconds': seconds,
        'expected_publish_labels': expected, 'seen_publish_labels': sorted(seen)})
    save()
    return seen

try:
    identity = success(obs('identity', 'us-east-1', 'sts', 'get-caller-identity', {}))
    if identity['Account'] != ACCOUNT or identity['Arn'] != 'arn:aws:iam::000000000000:user/Delegated':
        raise RuntimeError('Unexpected identity; refusing mutation')
    regions = success(obs('regions-read-only', 'us-east-1', 'account', 'list-regions', {}))['Regions']
    statuses = {r['RegionName']: r['RegionOptStatus'] for r in regions}
    if any(statuses.get(r) != 'ENABLED' for r in ['ap-south-2', 'ap-southeast-3']):
        raise RuntimeError('Required opt-in Regions are not already enabled; refusing mutation')
    east_topic = topic('us-east-1')
    opt_topic = topic('ap-south-2')
    east_dlq = queue('east-dlq', 'us-east-1', east_topic, ['sns.amazonaws.com', 'sns.us-east-1.amazonaws.com'])
    opt_dlq = queue('opt-dlq', 'ap-south-2', opt_topic, ['sns.amazonaws.com', 'sns.ap-south-2.amazonaws.com'])
    topologies = [
        ('default-to-optin', 'us-east-1', 'ap-south-2', east_topic, east_dlq,
            [('generic', 'sns.amazonaws.com'), ('target-regional', 'sns.ap-south-2.amazonaws.com')]),
        ('optin-to-default', 'ap-south-2', 'us-west-2', opt_topic, opt_dlq,
            [('generic', 'sns.amazonaws.com'), ('source-regional', 'sns.ap-south-2.amazonaws.com')]),
        ('optin-to-optin', 'ap-south-2', 'ap-southeast-3', opt_topic, opt_dlq,
            [('generic', 'sns.amazonaws.com'), ('source-regional', 'sns.ap-south-2.amazonaws.com'), ('target-regional', 'sns.ap-southeast-3.amazonaws.com')]),
        ('same-optin', 'ap-south-2', 'ap-south-2', opt_topic, opt_dlq,
            [('generic', 'sns.amazonaws.com'), ('regional', 'sns.ap-south-2.amazonaws.com')])]
    for name, source, destination, arn, dlq, variants in topologies:
        for variant, principal in variants:
            label = name + '-' + variant
            q = queue(label, destination, arn, principal)
            subscribe(label, source, arn, q, dlq, principal)
    data['optin_cases'] = cases
    save()
    time.sleep(20)
    for case in cases:
        publish(case)
    missing = []
    for case in cases:
        seen = receive(case['queue'], case['label'] + '-destination', [case['label']], 15)
        if case['label'] not in seen:
            missing.append(case)
    for dlq in [east_dlq, opt_dlq]:
        labels = [case['label'] for case in missing if case['dead_letter_queue']['arn'] == dlq['arn']]
        if labels:
            receive(dlq, dlq['name'] + '-failure-evidence', labels, 95)
    for case in missing:
        if not any(case['label'] in r.get('correlated_publish_labels', []) for r in data['receipts']):
            receive(case['queue'], case['label'] + '-final-destination', [case['label']], 15)
except Exception as exc:

import json
import os
import sys
import time
import uuid
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from pathlib import Path
ROOT = Path('/home/r/dev/minor/stackd')
sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT / 'scripts/aws'))
from aws_cli import observe
ACCOUNT = '000000000000'
OUT = ROOT / 'testdata/aws/sns/regional_sqs.json'
data = json.loads(OUT.read_text())
PREFIX = 'stackd-sns-regctx-' + uuid.uuid4().hex[:12]
topics = []
queues = []
subs = []
cases = []

def save():
    OUT.write_text(json.dumps(data, indent=2) + '\n')

def obs(label, region, service, operation, params, cleanup=False):
    result = observe(service, operation, params, dict(os.environ, AWS_REGION=region, AWS_DEFAULT_REGION=region, AWS_MAX_ATTEMPTS='1', AWS_PAGER=''))
    data['cleanup' if cleanup else 'observations'].append({'label': 'actor-' + label, 'region': region,
        'service': service, 'operation': operation, 'input': params, 'result': result,
        'observed': datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()})
    save()
    print(label, result['code'], flush=True)
    return result

def success(result):
    if result['code'] != 'Success':
        raise RuntimeError(json.dumps(result))
    return result['output']

def topic(region):
    arn = success(obs('topic-' + region, region, 'sns', 'create-topic', {'Name': PREFIX + '-' + region}))['TopicArn']
    topics.append({'region': region, 'arn': arn})
    return arn

def queue(label, region, arn, mode, principal, denied=None):
    name = PREFIX + '-' + label
    url = success(obs('queue-' + label, region, 'sqs', 'create-queue', {'QueueName': name}))['QueueUrl']
    q = {'name': name, 'url': url, 'region': region}
    queues.append(q)
    q['arn'] = success(obs('queue-attributes-' + label, region, 'sqs', 'get-queue-attributes', {'QueueUrl': url, 'AttributeNames': ['All']}))['Attributes']['QueueArn']
    conditions = {'ArnEquals': {'aws:SourceArn': arn}, 'StringEquals': {'aws:SourceAccount': ACCOUNT}}
    actor = {'Service': principal}
    if mode == 'name':
        actor = '*'
        conditions['StringEquals']['aws:PrincipalServiceName'] = principal
    if mode == 'list':
        actor = '*'
        conditions['ForAnyValue:StringEquals'] = {'aws:PrincipalServiceNamesList': principal}
    statements = [{'Effect': 'Allow', 'Principal': actor, 'Action': 'sqs:SendMessage', 'Resource': q['arn'], 'Condition': conditions}]
    if denied:
        statements.append({'Effect': 'Deny', 'Principal': {'Service': denied}, 'Action': 'sqs:SendMessage', 'Resource': q['arn']})
    policy = {'Version': '2012-10-17', 'Statement': statements}
    success(obs('policy-' + label, region, 'sqs', 'set-queue-attributes', {'QueueUrl': url, 'Attributes': {'Policy': json.dumps(policy)}}))
    obs('policy-readback-' + label, region, 'sqs', 'get-queue-attributes', {'QueueUrl': url, 'AttributeNames': ['All']})
    return q

def subscription(label, source, arn, endpoint, attributes=None):
    params = {'TopicArn': arn, 'Protocol': 'sqs', 'Endpoint': endpoint, 'ReturnSubscriptionArn': True}
    if attributes is not None:
        params['Attributes'] = attributes
    result = obs('subscribe-' + label, source, 'sns', 'subscribe', params)
    if result['code'] != 'Success':
        return None
    sub = {'region': source, 'arn': result['output']['SubscriptionArn']}
    subs.append(sub)
    obs('subscription-readback-' + label, source, 'sns', 'get-subscription-attributes', {'SubscriptionArn': sub['arn']})
    return sub

def publish(case):
    label = case['label']
    body = json.dumps({'probe': PREFIX, 'case': label, 'payload': 'principal context discrimination'})
    params = {'TopicArn': case['topic'], 'Message': body,
              'MessageAttributes': {'ProbeCase': {'DataType': 'String', 'StringValue': label}}}
    result = obs('publish-' + label, case['source_region'], 'sns', 'publish', params)
    if result['code'] == 'Success':
        data['publish_ids'][label] = {'message_id': result['output']['MessageId'], 'body': body, 'input': params}
        save()

def receive(q, label, expected, seconds):
    started = datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()
    deadline = time.monotonic() + seconds
    seen = set()
    count = 0
    while time.monotonic() < deadline and not set(expected).issubset(seen):
        count += 1
        result = obs(label + '-receive-' + str(count), q['region'], 'sqs', 'receive-message',
            {'QueueUrl': q['url'], 'MaxNumberOfMessages': 10, 'WaitTimeSeconds': 10,
             'MessageSystemAttributeNames': ['All'], 'MessageAttributeNames': ['All']})
        for message in result.get('output', {}).get('Messages', []):
            body = message['Body']
            try:
                decoded = json.loads(body)
            except ValueError:
                decoded = {}
            matched = [key for key, pub in data['publish_ids'].items() if body == pub['body']
                or decoded.get('MessageId') == pub['message_id'] or decoded.get('Message') == pub['body']]
            seen.update(matched)
            data['receipts'].append({'label': 'actor-' + label, 'region': q['region'], 'destination': q['arn'],
                'message': message, 'correlated_publish_labels': matched,
                'correlated_publish_ids': [data['publish_ids'][key]['message_id'] for key in matched],
                'observed': datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()})
            save()
            obs(label + '-delete-receipt-' + str(len(data['receipts'])), q['region'], 'sqs', 'delete-message',
                {'QueueUrl': q['url'], 'ReceiptHandle': message['ReceiptHandle']})
    data['delivery_windows'].append({'label': 'actor-' + label, 'destination': q['arn'], 'started': started,
        'finished': datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(), 'bound_seconds': seconds,
        'expected_publish_labels': expected, 'seen_publish_labels': sorted(seen)})
    save()
    return seen

try:
    identity = success(obs('identity', 'us-east-1', 'sts', 'get-caller-identity', {}))
    if identity['Account'] != ACCOUNT or identity['Arn'] != 'arn:aws:iam::000000000000:user/Delegated':
        raise RuntimeError('Unexpected identity; refusing mutation')
    regions = success(obs('regions-read-only', 'us-east-1', 'account', 'list-regions', {}))['Regions']
    if not any(r['RegionName'] == 'ap-south-2' and r['RegionOptStatus'] == 'ENABLED' for r in regions):
        raise RuntimeError('Opt-in Region is not already enabled; refusing mutation')
    east_topic = topic('us-east-1')
    opt_topic = topic('ap-south-2')
    east_dlq = queue('east-dlq', 'us-east-1', east_topic, 'principal', ['sns.amazonaws.com', 'sns.us-east-1.amazonaws.com'])
    opt_dlq = queue('opt-dlq', 'ap-south-2', opt_topic, 'principal', ['sns.amazonaws.com', 'sns.ap-south-2.amazonaws.com'])
    for token in ['not-a-region', 'us-west-999']:
        endpoint = 'arn:aws:sqs:' + token + ':' + ACCOUNT + ':' + PREFIX + '-nonexistent'
        subscription('invalid-endpoint-region-' + token, 'us-east-1', east_topic, endpoint)
    generic = 'sns.amazonaws.com'
    regional = 'sns.ap-south-2.amazonaws.com'
    variants = [('name-generic', 'name', generic, None), ('name-regional', 'name', regional, None),
                ('list-generic', 'list', generic, None), ('list-regional', 'list', regional, None),
                ('allow-generic-deny-regional', 'principal', generic, regional),
                ('allow-regional-deny-generic', 'principal', regional, generic)]
    for direction, source, destination, arn, dlq in [
        ('default-opt', 'us-east-1', 'ap-south-2', east_topic, east_dlq),
        ('opt-default', 'ap-south-2', 'us-west-2', opt_topic, opt_dlq)]:
        for variant, mode, principal, denied in variants:
            label = 'ctx-' + direction + '-' + variant
            q = queue(label, destination, arn, mode, principal, denied)
            sub = subscription(label, source, arn, q['arn'], {'RedrivePolicy': json.dumps({'deadLetterTargetArn': dlq['arn']}),
                'FilterPolicy': json.dumps({'ProbeCase': [label]})})
            if sub:
                cases.append({'label': label, 'source_region': source, 'destination_region': destination,
                    'topic': arn, 'queue': q, 'dead_letter_queue': dlq, 'subscription': sub['arn'],
                    'policy_mode': mode, 'principal_value': principal, 'denied_principal': denied})
    data['actor_cases'] = cases
    save()
    time.sleep(20)
    for case in cases:
        publish(case)
    missing = []
    for case in cases:
        if case['label'] not in receive(case['queue'], case['label'] + '-destination', [case['label']], 12):
            missing.append(case)
    for dlq in [east_dlq, opt_dlq]:
        labels = [case['label'] for case in missing if case['dead_letter_queue']['arn'] == dlq['arn']]
        if labels:
            receive(dlq, dlq['name'] + '-failure-evidence', labels, 95)
    for case in missing:
        if not any(case['label'] in r.get('correlated_publish_labels', []) for r in data['receipts']):
            receive(case['queue'], case['label'] + '-final-destination', [case['label']], 15)
except Exception as exc:
    data['actor_probe_error'] = type(exc).__name__ + ': ' + str(exc)
    save()
    print(data['actor_probe_error'], flush=True)
finally:
    for sub in subs:
        obs('unsubscribe-' + sub['arn'].rsplit(':', 1)[-1], sub['region'], 'sns', 'unsubscribe', {'SubscriptionArn': sub['arn']}, cleanup=True)
    for t in topics:
        obs('delete-topic-' + t['region'], t['region'], 'sns', 'delete-topic', {'TopicArn': t['arn']}, cleanup=True)
    for q in queues:
        obs('delete-queue-' + q['name'], q['region'], 'sqs', 'delete-queue', {'QueueUrl': q['url']}, cleanup=True)
    time.sleep(3)
    for sub in subs:
        obs('verify-subscription-absent-' + sub['arn'].rsplit(':', 1)[-1], sub['region'], 'sns', 'get-subscription-attributes', {'SubscriptionArn': sub['arn']}, cleanup=True)
    for t in topics:
        obs('verify-topic-absent-' + t['region'], t['region'], 'sns', 'get-topic-attributes', {'TopicArn': t['arn']}, cleanup=True)
    for q in queues:
        obs('verify-queue-absent-' + q['name'], q['region'], 'sqs', 'get-queue-attributes', {'QueueUrl': q['url'], 'AttributeNames': ['QueueArn']}, cleanup=True)
        obs('verify-queue-name-absent-' + q['name'], q['region'], 'sqs', 'get-queue-url', {'QueueName': q['name']}, cleanup=True)
    for region in sorted({q['region'] for q in queues}):
